say:2:1220304001:0.text: What are you talking about? Don't try and trick me! There's no such thing as a fish-eating rat!
say:2:1220304001:0.source_cn: 你在说什么？少坑我！哪有吃鱼的老鼠啊？

say:3:1220304002:0.text: You're kidding, right? They're nature's least picky eater. They eat everything!
say:3:1220304002:0.source_cn: 怎么没有？老鼠可不挑食，它们啥都吃！

say:6:1220304003:0.text: Isn't it unhealthy to eat everything? They'll get stomachaches all the time.
say:6:1220304003:0.source_cn: 什么都吃对身体不好吧？

say:10:1220304005:0.text: Oh, you're that cute rodent that follows the mage around. I've been wondering what your cheeks feel like.
say:10:1220304005:0.source_cn: 啊，是魔法师大人家的小可爱。真想摸一摸！
say:10:1220304005:0.male: Oh, you're that cute rodent that follows the mage around. I've been wondering what your cheeks feel like.
say:10:1220304005:0.female: Oh, you're that cute rodent that follows the mage around. I've been wondering what your cheeks feel like.

say:11:1220304006:0.text: But I don't have time to think about that now! If Lucca knew that all the fish were gone, he's gonna be furious.
say:11:1220304006:0.source_cn: 不对，现在可没空想这个！要是让二当家知道鱼都没了，他肯...
say:11:1220304006:0.male: But I don't have time to think about that now! If Lucca knew that all the fish were gone, he's gonna be furious.
say:11:1220304006:0.female: But I don't have time to think about that now! If Lucca knew that all the fish were gone, he's gonna be furious.

say:12:1220304007:0.text: Luckily, he's not here right now. I need to fix this before he finds out.
say:12:1220304007:0.source_cn: 幸好二当家不在，趁他还没发现，我得——
say:12:1220304007:0.male: Luckily, he's not here right now. I need to fix this before he finds out.
say:12:1220304007:0.female: Luckily, he's not here right now. I need to fix this before he finds out.

say:13:1220304008:0.source_cn: 其实，我们是替卢卡过来看看的。

say:14:1220304009:1.text: Look, he even gave us this.
say:14:1220304009:1.source_cn: 你看这个，是卢卡交给我们的。

say:16:1220304011:0.text: Please! Don't tell Lucca what happened.
say:16:1220304011:0.source_cn: 求求你们！千万别告诉二当家！
say:16:1220304011:0.male: Please! Don't tell Lucca what happened.
say:16:1220304011:0.female: Please! Don't tell Lucca what happened.

say:17:1220304012:1.text: I can't make any more mistakes this month. I've already used up all the chances I've been given, and the month isn't even halfway through!
say:17:1220304012:1.source_cn: 我这个月只剩下一次犯错的机会，但这个月还没过半呢！
say:17:1220304012:1.male: I can't make any more mistakes this month. I've already used up all the chances I've been given, and the month isn't even halfway through!
say:17:1220304012:1.female: I can't make any more mistakes this month. I've already used up all the chances I've been given, and the month isn't even halfway through!

say:18:1220304013:0.text: If it's not your fault, Lucca won't blame you. He's actually nice.
say:18:1220304013:0.source_cn: 如果不是你的错，卢卡也不会怪你的，他是好人。

say:19:1220304014:0.text: Tell us about the fish you just mentioned.
say:19:1220304014:0.source_cn: 你们刚才提到的鱼是怎么回事？

say:20:1220304015:1.text: We always buy fish from this guy, and he usually delivers his freshest catch.
say:20:1220304015:1.source_cn: 我们一向找这个男的买鱼，他会把最新鲜的鱼送过来。
say:20:1220304015:1.male: We always buy fish from this guy, and he usually delivers his freshest catch.
say:20:1220304015:1.female: We always buy fish from this guy, and he usually delivers his freshest catch.

say:21:1220304016:0.text: But when I came to pick up the fish today, the catch was gone. There was only some stinkin' fish blood and a few scales on the ground!
say:21:1220304016:0.source_cn: 可是今天我来拿鱼的时候，鱼没了，只有一地臭烘烘的鱼血和鱼鳞！
say:21:1220304016:0.male: But when I came to pick up the fish today, the catch was gone. There was only some stinkin' fish blood and a few scales on the ground!
say:21:1220304016:0.female: But when I came to pick up the fish today, the catch was gone. There was only some stinkin' fish blood and a few scales on the ground!

say:24:1220304017:0.text: I put out the fish for you. How is it my fault that they disappeared?
say:24:1220304017:0.source_cn: 我明明把给你们的货放在这里，谁知道一眨眼就没了？
say:24:1220304017:0.male: I put out the fish for you. How is it my fault that they disappeared?
say:24:1220304017:0.female: I put out the fish for you. How is it my fault that they disappeared?

say:25:1220304018:0.text: See! There's a hole in this basket. A rat definitely got to it. Go and settle your score with the rat! Don't bother me.
say:25:1220304018:0.source_cn: 装鱼的筐被咬出了好大一个洞，那咬痕一看就是老鼠的，你找...
say:25:1220304018:0.male: See! There's a hole in this basket. A rat definitely got to it. Go and settle your score with the rat! Don't bother me.
say:25:1220304018:0.female: See! There's a hole in this basket. A rat definitely got to it. Go and settle your score with the rat! Don't bother me.

say:26:1220304019:0.text: Something seems fishy... Ha! I made a joke! Anyway, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?
say:26:1220304019:0.male: Something seems fishy... Ha! I made a joke! Anyway, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?
say:26:1220304019:0.female: Something seems fishy... Ha! I made a joke! Anyway, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?

choice_prompt:27:1220304019.text: Something seems fishy... Ha! I made a joke! Anyway, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?
choice_prompt:27:1220304019.source_cn: 好像有哪里不太对劲……<style=stress><player_name></style>，你怎么看？
choice_prompt:27:1220304019.male: Something seems fishy... Ha! I made a joke! Anyway, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?
choice_prompt:27:1220304019.female: Something seems fishy... Ha! I made a joke! Anyway, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?

say:28:1220304020:0.text: Yes, most mice are tiny and can only take away one at a time.
say:28:1220304020:0.source_cn: 是啊，老鼠的体型很小，顶多只能叼走一两条鱼。
say:28:1220304020:0.male: Yes, most mice are tiny and can only take away one at a time.
say:28:1220304020:0.female: Yes, most mice are tiny and can only take away one at a time.

say:31:1220304022:0.text: What do you have to say for yourself, fishmonger?!
say:31:1220304022:0.source_cn: 卖鱼的，这回你还有什么话说！

say:32:1220304023:0.text: What do you want me to do? Even if I start now, I can't catch the number of fish you need by myself.
say:32:1220304023:0.source_cn: 你想让我咋搞嘛？光靠我，现在也不可能给你捞上来这么多鱼！

say:33:1220304024:0.text: Our boss likes to serve these fish to our guests as a special treat! If anything goes wrong, you'll be sleeping with the fishes!
say:33:1220304024:0.source_cn: 这些鱼是我们老大用来招待贵客的！要是有什么闪失，你就完蛋了！

say:36:1220304025:0.text: Are we the guests that Sonja wants to treat? Chippy doesn't want to miss this feast...
say:36:1220304025:0.source_cn: 索尼娅要招待的贵客，该不会是我们吧？不想错过大餐啊……
say:36:1220304025:0.male: Are we the guests that Sonja wants to treat? Chippy doesn't want to miss this feast...
say:36:1220304025:0.female: Are we the guests that Sonja wants to treat? Chippy doesn't want to miss this feast...

say:37:1220304026:0.text: Why are you always like this when we're talking about food, Chippy? I've said it a dozen times. We're familiars, so we don't need to eat. The magister's magic is enough.
say:37:1220304026:0.source_cn: 每次说到吃，满满都会露出这幅表情……我们明明不需要吃东...
say:37:1220304026:0.male: Why are you always like this when we're talking about food, Chippy? I've said it a dozen times. We're familiars, so we don't need to eat. The magister's magic is enough.
say:37:1220304026:0.female: Why are you always like this when we're talking about food, Chippy? I've said it a dozen times. We're familiars, so we don't need to eat. The magister's magic is enough.

say:39:1220304027:0.text: I see you got fishing rods. You know how to fish, right?
say:39:1220304027:0.source_cn: 我看你们也有鱼竿，你们会钓鱼吗？
say:39:1220304027:0.male: I see you got fishing rods. You know how to fish, right?
say:39:1220304027:0.female: I see you got fishing rods. You know how to fish, right?

say:40:1220304028:0.text: Wait a minute... Are you the one that hooked that damedangler? Everyone's talking about you!
say:40:1220304028:0.source_cn: 等等……说起来，你不就是那个钓起了冥湾美人的家伙吗！好...
say:40:1220304028:0.male: Wait a minute... Are you the one that hooked that damedangler? Everyone's talking about you!
say:40:1220304028:0.female: Wait a minute... Are you the one that hooked that damedangler? Everyone's talking about you!

say:41:1220304029:0.text: Look, I don't have enough fish in my shop for the Whispers. Can you help a guy out? Especially with your skills, we'll be done in no time.
say:41:1220304029:0.source_cn: 我店里剩的鱼不够，你能不能帮我钓鱼？多一个人，多一份力……
say:41:1220304029:0.male: Look, I don't have enough fish in my shop for the Whispers. Can you help a guy out? Especially with your skills, we'll be done in no time.
say:41:1220304029:0.female: Look, I don't have enough fish in my shop for the Whispers. Can you help a guy out? Especially with your skills, we'll be done in no time.

choice_prompt:42:1220304029.text: Look, I don't have enough fish in my shop for the Whispers. Can you help a guy out? Especially with your skills, we'll be done in no time.
choice_prompt:42:1220304029.source_cn: 我店里剩的鱼不够，你能不能帮我钓鱼？多一个人，多一份力……
choice_prompt:42:1220304029.male: Look, I don't have enough fish in my shop for the Whispers. Can you help a guy out? Especially with your skills, we'll be done in no time.
choice_prompt:42:1220304029.female: Look, I don't have enough fish in my shop for the Whispers. Can you help a guy out? Especially with your skills, we'll be done in no time.

say:43:1220304030:0.text: Well, I ain't gonna let you work for free.
say:43:1220304030:0.male: Well, I ain't gonna let you work for free.
say:43:1220304030:0.female: Well, I ain't gonna let you work for free.

say:45:1220304032:0.text: If you leave from the south gate and head west, there's a good fishing spot. I saw plenty of fish biting last time I was there.
say:45:1220304032:0.source_cn: 从南边的城门出去，往西走有个适合垂钓的地方，那里比较多。
say:45:1220304032:0.male: If you leave from the south gate and head west, there's a good fishing spot. I saw plenty of fish biting last time I was there.
say:45:1220304032:0.female: If you leave from the south gate and head west, there's a good fishing spot. I saw plenty of fish biting last time I was there.

say:46:1220304033:0.text: Once you catch the grass carp, come meet me at the market near the docks.
say:46:1220304033:0.source_cn: 你们钓上了鱼，就到码头附近的市场来找我吧。
say:46:1220304033:0.male: Once you catch the grass carp, come meet me at the market near the docks.
say:46:1220304033:0.female: Once you catch the grass carp, come meet me at the market near the docks.

choice:27:0:1.text: One mouse can't eat a basket of fish.
choice:27:0:1.male: One mouse can't eat a basket of fish.
choice:27:0:1.female: One mouse can't eat a basket of fish.

say:48:1220304021:0.text: That's right. It's impossible for a mouse to eat a whole basket of fish in an instant.
say:48:1220304021:0.source_cn: 没错，光凭老鼠，不可能在一瞬间吃掉一筐鱼。
say:48:1220304021:0.male: That's right. It's impossible for a mouse to eat a whole basket of fish in an instant.
say:48:1220304021:0.female: That's right. It's impossible for a mouse to eat a whole basket of fish in an instant.
